description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) as a function of the number of queries used during inference for different Document Ranking (DR) strategies. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and is a linear scale ranging from 33.5 to 6.0. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different DR strategy: "DRP w/o query," "DRP w/ gold," "DRP w/ top-1," "DRP w/ random," "DRP w/ bottom-1," and "DRP w/ curriculum." The "DRP w/o query" line is solid and red, starting at an MRR of approximately 35.5 and ending at around 6.0. The "DRP w/ gold" line is dashed and green, beginning at about 35.5 and ending near 6.0. The "DRP w/ top-1" line is dotted and blue, starting at roughly 35.5 and ending close to 6.0. The "DRP w/ random" line is dash-dot and purple, beginning at about 35.5 and ending near 6.0. The "DRP w/ bottom-1" line is solid and yellow, starting at approximately 35.5 and ending close to 6.0. The "DRP w/ curriculum" line is dotted and orange, beginning at around 35.5 and ending near 6.0. All lines show a general decline in MRR as the number of queries used during inference increases.
